Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 25-Nov-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  Ethical Hacking [NPT_4125]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                   Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                Implement how TCP three-way handshake behavior can be exploited during reconnaissance.                 (5)  
  
  
  A)                                                         Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Apply how subnetting assists in isolating network segments to improve security and performance.        (5)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
2)                Examine the security implications of routing protocols such as RIP and OSPF in dynamic networks. (5)  
  
  
  A)                                                         Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Implement the role of Google Dorks and archive.org in passive information gathering.                   (5)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3)                Explain how MAC spoofing affects ARP tables and network integrity.                                     (5)  
  
  
  A)                                                        Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  B)           Analyze how symmetric and asymmetric encryption schemes differ in performance and security.            (5)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
4)                Analyze how cryptographic hash functions ensure data integrity and authenticity in message             (5)  
  transmission.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Examine how steganography conceals information compared to encryption, with examples.                  (5)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
5)                Analyze how packet sniffing via Wireshark can expose credentials and how encryption mitigates the (5)  
  risk.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Evaluate lessons learned from real-world case studies of DDoS attacks and mitigation techniques.       (5)
